cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(replay_probe_cpp)
if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
endif()
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(std_msgs REQUIRED)
foreach(exe talker_cpp mixer_cpp listener_cpp)
  add_executable(${exe} src/${exe}.cpp)
  target_include_directories(${exe} PRIVATE src)
  ament_target_dependencies(${exe} rclcpp std_msgs)
  install(TARGETS ${exe} DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})
endforeach()
ament_package()
